note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). Object A is a generic fictional object; no person is drawn and no state is shown as a harm caused by someone. The two states (prior condition / later change) and the levels are supplied placeholders on an illustrative scale, never real figures; nothing is measured, valued, attributed or decided, and no cause, fault, liability or outcome is stated. The relationships drawn are exactly those supplied, each with its kind; no preset supplies a causal link, so no causal arrow is drawn. Omitted brief fields (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, 2026-10-05): none — events, causalLinks, alternatives and losses are editable, with the mechanism fields (elements, relationships, focusElement, relationLabels, traversalOrder); 'object' and 'levels' are added. Long-labels-stress: coordinator decision (standing stress-cap rule, docs/AUTHORING.md item 20, from LAW-0687/0689–0692; subject floor: 'Subject ≥ 0.20 of the frame height at rest and hold (causation-05 LAW-0700 decision)', production/SESSION_HANDOFF.md). True driver: the 1:1 box (each mini panel on its plinth must reach 0.20 of the frame height). After trying the fallback layouts (record over the pieces with the variation piece in the top band; pieces beside the record; stacked or side-by-side captions), the full stress counts did not fit 1:1. Measured, rendered at 1080p (2026-10-05; pre-cap copy saved in production/scratch/causation-07/LAW-0706.stress-precap.json): full counts (five entries, two accounts, one labelled link, two variation items, five elements) → 1:1 fallback scale k 0.769, 17 px, panel 0.083 of the frame height; 16:9 21 px / 0.237; 9:16 20 px / 0.227. Four entries without accounts or link and with one variation item: 1:1 0.186 (under the floor). The stress keeps every text at its near-maximum length and caps the COUNTS at three entries, no account, no link note, one variation item and the four baseline elements (baseline 3 / 0 / 0 / 1 / 4); after the cap: 1:1 20 px / 0.203 without scaling; 16:9 23 px / 0.311; 9:16 25 px / 0.230. Every text field stays longer than the baseline and every count ≥ the baseline. The contrast-or-alternative preset keeps one variation item (with its second item the 1:1 panel measured 0.163).
